sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The rhetorical question (*költői kérdés*) is not an inquiry, but an emphatic assertion disguised as a question. The particle *vajon* introduces high-register intellectual interrogation: *Vajon joggal állítható-e, hogy a társadalom érdekeit képviselik? Aligha.*

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In impassioned polemics, a succession of rapid rhetorical questions builds unbearable tension before the final declarative resolution.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Vajon hihetünk-e még a szép szavaknak?
Can we indeed still believe in fine words?
Joggal állítható-e, hogy nem tudtunk a veszélyről?
Can it rightly be claimed that we knew nothing of the danger?
Why, is there any proof more obvious than this?
